message: The other day, I found myself in a bit of a pickle when the kids were suddenly sent home from school early due to a storm warning. I was frantically scrambling to gather everyone and make sure we had snacks and games to keep us occupied. Thankfully, I had taken the time to prepare a little go-bag with some essentials — snacks, water, and even a few favorite books. It felt like a small win that turned a potentially stressful afternoon into a cozy family adventure. 🌧️ How do you prepare for those unexpected moments?
